newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends lower on spreading.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends lower on spreading.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures ended lower, with nearbys weaker on spreading and moderate commercial pressure, traders said.
"The feature today is the spread. Also, we saw some commercials like Cargill selling the front end and buying deferreds," a MGE broker said.
The March/May spread was on the defensive early, narrowing to 16 cents before closing at 16 cents bid/17 cents offer.
Traders said the March/May spread drew pressure from the recent improvement in the transportation problems that have tied up grain shipment in the northern U.S. Plains.
"Most of the wheat coming into the market is because of rail transportation freeing up, not because of new farmer sales," a trader said.
MGE spring wheat settled 3/4 to 2-3/4 cents per bushel lower, with March down 2-3/4 cents at $3.84-3/4.
Traders said Cargill Investor Services sold one million March and bought 800,000 July spring wheat bushels. Country Hedging bull-spread 600,000 March/May and bear-spread 400,000 May/March.
MGE barley settled two to five cents per cwt higher, with March up five cents at $6.55 a bushel.
